pages.text: Every recipe needs fuel and draws $(item)20 mB of hot air per tick$() while it works. Base times are for a short furnace; see the next page for height.$(br2)$(l)Crushed raw iron + 1 limesand$()$(br)$(item)144 mB$() molten steel, 144 mB slag, furnace gas. Base 400 ticks.

Base 800 ticks: same speed per ingot, but crushing the ore first lets you use Create's ore processing.$(br2)$(l)Iron dust + 1 limesand$()$(br)Only when another mod adds iron dust: 144 mB steel and slag. $(l)Quartz$()$(br)$(item)40 mB liquid silicon$(), no flux. Base 100 ticks. Cast it into silicon ingots.$(br2)The two output tanks hold $(item)4000 mB$() each and only accept the fluid already in them. Pump them empty before switching from steel to silicon, or the furnace will wait.
